messages:
matt: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — I'm summarizing remediation owners, concrete ETAs, and recurrence checks so we can close the loop. I'll add items below; please assign or correct and confirm timelines.

sara: Thanks. I'll start. high-level: (1) token ingest lag fix, (2) delayed invoice backfill, (3) alerting + runbook updates, (4) recurring pattern detection.

josh: Assign me for #1 (token ingest lag). Root cause looked like the s3 partition rename race + bad retry window. ETA: wobble window fix + unit tests by Tue, canary deploy Wed.

matt: @josh noted. Add JIRA FIN-8420 for the fix and FIN-8421 for canary rollout docs. Acceptance criteria: no duplicate keys in ingest for 24h during canary + downstream ledger counts match by account.

sara: For #2 (invoice backfill) owner: @priya. Priya, can you confirm the runbook and customer-facing timeline? We should avoid manual credits if possible.

priya: Confirmed. Plan: run a targeted reprocess for affected dates (2026-03-17..2026-03-19), validate token counts against raw logs, stage credits-only fallback. ETA: validation scripts Friday EOD, reprocess next Mon. JIRA FIN-8433.

sara: Put a hard cutoff for manual credits: only if reprocess fails verification. Otherwise automated ledger patch and invoice reissue.

matt: Good. For billing communications: draft msg to impacted customers ready by Thurs AM. I'll own the customer comms with @support on standby.

josh: Adding the quick debug snippet that showed the partition rename race — saved for root-cause notes:

```
2026-03-18T02:14:32Z ingest-service ERROR partition rename failed: ENOENT -> retrying
2026-03-18T02:14:32Z ingest-service WARN retry-window=0.5s attempts=3
2026-03-18T02:14:33Z ledger-writer INFO wrote token-batch size=0 account=acct_123
```

josh: Fix is to make rename atomic (temp dir + mv) and increase retry window to 10s for rename ops. Also add metric partition_rename_failures.

priya: For #3 (alerting + runbook) — owner: sara. Need a runbook section: detection query, triage steps, mitigation, and customer comm template. Expected updates by Mon.

sara: Will do. I’ll add runbook PR and a short playbook: if partition_rename_failures > 0 for 5m then page on-call and auto-pause ingest for suspect prefix.

matt: On recurrence checks (#4) — ops asked for automated anomaly detection over token deltas. Owner: josh. Deliverable: weekly job that compares daily token deltas vs 30-day baseline and files FIN-8437 if spike > 2x. ETA: two weeks.

josh: Yep. Building on existing detect pipeline. I’ll schedule weekly email to finance + ops.

billing-bot: Invoice correction job queued: job_id=invfix-20260324-09 owner=priya scope=acct_123..acct_456 status=queued

priya: Noted. I’ll watch job status and post results. If verification passes, schedule invoice reissue for next billing cycle.

matt: To summarize owners & ETA: #1 josh (Tue/Wed), #2 priya (scripts Fri, reprocess Mon), #3 sara (Mon runbook PR), #4 josh (2 weeks). Can we lock these as commitments? react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm.

sara: :white_check_mark: locking.

josh: :white_check_mark: locking. FIN-8420/8437 created.

priya: :white_check_mark: locking. FIN-8433 created. Will post verification link when reprocess completes.

matt: I'll own the customer comms and postmortem closure doc. Next sync: Tuesday 09:30 to verify canary results and backfill validation. If anything slips, call it out here.

sara: ack. I'll update the runbook PR link here once ready.

josh: leaving note — add a regression test that replays partition rename under race to the CI harness. prevents this coming back.

priya: Also adding billing verification checklist: raw-log sample agreement, token-delta <1% for small accounts, escalation triggers.

matt: Great. Thanks all. Closing thread after Tue sync unless new blockers. :thumbsup:
